rationale: C23 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s congressional advocacy letter. Both open by renewing an earlier request for prompt legislation, develop the proposal’s economic and national-security significance, answer fiscal or economic objections, invoke bipartisan support, and close with a conviction-based recommendation that Congress act. The overlap is more concrete than a shared policy topic or routine correspondence formula. C13 parallels the welfare-and-security justification and prior legislative requests, while C16 supplies related budget and national-security context, but neither matches the child’s overall persuasive sequence as closely as C23.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I wish to express my earnest hope that the House of Representatives will take favorable action at this session upon legislation providing Federal aid
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I should like to express again the hope that the Congress will soon enact legislation approving the agreement
shared_material.explanation: Both begin by renewing a previously stated hope for prompt congressional enactment of a specific program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I regard the proper education of our youth as a matter of paramount importance to the welfare and security of the United States.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am personally convinced of the need for this project, both from the standpoint of our common economic welfare and of our national security.
shared_material.explanation: Both justify the requested legislation through the paired concepts of national welfare and security.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the question has been raised... as to whether it is necessary for us to forego providing Federal aid to education at this time... I am therefore convinced that the increases... present no valid reason for delaying
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The application of the principle of self-liquidation... should remove objections concerning the economic soundness of the enterprise... I therefore strongly recommend that the Congress enact legislation
shared_material.explanation: Each addresses an economic objection before moving to a conviction-based concluding recommendation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: A bill... has recently been passed in the Senate by a substantial majority of both parties. I hope that legislation... will soon be passed also by the House
shared_material.parent_excerpt: That is why it has been a measure strongly supported by both parties... I therefore strongly recommend that the Congress enact legislation
shared_material.explanation: Both invoke bipartisan support and end by pressing Congress for enactment.
